title: “Burning” by The Sea At Midnight is a song for a planet in peril
htmlContent:
The Sea At Midnight has released a powerful new single called "Burning" in collaboration with Chemical Waves. The raw and emotional vocals express despair and a fighting spirit, highlighting the struggle between feeling powerless and needing action.

"Burning" grabs your attention with its intense energy. It combines dark, atmospheric rock with urgent lyrics that paint a clear picture of a world facing serious problems. The haunting melody flows beautifully, reflecting the dire consequences we may face if we ignore the signs about our environment. Working with Chemical Waves adds an exciting edge that amplifies the song's emotional depth.

https://open.spotify.com/album/72inMVfVxZnIGaqioyYNv6?si=tY6evoEcRqKPm6ePfjtQdw

"Burning" creates a strong impact through its contrasts. Its rich production blends sadness and energy, giving the song a powerful, cinematic feel. In a time when discussions about climate change can seem far away or abstract, "Burning" brings the issue right to the forefront. The Sea At Midnight wants listeners to truly feel the message in this song.
